subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should PR #97580 land as an incremental internal compaction/pruning step, be split down to the proven LLM pruning and summary-framing pieces, or defer the multi-pass architecture to #58398 and the direct timeout repair to #92899?
rationale: The answer determines core session-state behavior, public harness surface, and whether unintegrated multi-pass code should be carried in production source before the architecture is accepted.

options.title: Split to proven incremental pieces
options.body: Keep only narrowly reviewed LLM-path pruning or summary-framing changes, remove or fully repair the unintegrated multi-pass helper, and require real session proof before merge.

options.title: Sponsor the full architecture here
options.body: Have a maintainer accept the multi-pass design in this PR, then require production caller wiring, fresh per-pass state handling, conflict resolution, and broad session-state proof.

options.title: Defer to canonical work
options.body: Close or pause this PR in favor of #58398 for architecture and #92899 for the direct timeout partial-progress repair.

recommendation.title: Split to proven incremental pieces
recommendation.body: Keep only narrowly reviewed LLM-path pruning or summary-framing changes, remove or fully repair the unintegrated multi-pass helper, and require real session proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is the assigned reviewer on the live PR and can route the PR-specific split, pause, or architecture-review decision.
